entries.summary: First public release on WordPress.org -- Free tier shipped fully standalone.
fixed: Serve /llms.txt at template_redirect priority 1 to beat redirect_canonical.
Match /llms.txt with or without trailing slash.
Invalidate stale markdown transients on save_post / before_delete_post.
improved: Standalone refactor -- license module talks directly to Lemon Squeezy License API; no JWT, no backend hop.
AI Crawler Allowlist -- allow / block any of 14 supported bots from settings.
Schema engine -- Article and FAQPage JSON-LD with conflict detection across 15+ SEO plugins.
BYO API keys for Pro citation tracking (Perplexity, Tavily).
Dashboard reads 100% from local wp_quoted_bot_log -- no external calls.
security: P1 hardening rollup: serializer safety, JS XSS guard, proxy trust, JWT validation, AJAX returns.
entries.notes: Pro tier UI auto-appears once the Lemon Squeezy store is configured. Until then the plugin runs Free-only.
Internal alpha. Not yet published to WordPress.org.
